specials.name: EXPANDING LEGENDARY FRAME WARRIORS
specials.behavior:
When a high-paying Warrior symbol lands with a Legendary Frame, it expands into a Legendary Frame Warrior if the symbol is part of at least 1 winning combination.

 Legendary Frame Warriors only expand upward, to the top of the grid. Legendary Frame Warriors that land on the top row count as regular high-paying symbols. Only 1 Legendary Frame can be present on a reel at a time.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - CLAWS OF DESTINY
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.retrigger:
extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the base game's mechanics and increases the chance of landing Legendary Frame Warriors!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - BATTLE OF THE BEASTS
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.retrigger:
extra free spins:

modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the features of the CLAWS OF DESTINY bonus. In addition, when a win occurs and a Legendary Frame Warrior expands, all symbols of the same kind will also expand into Legendary Frame Warriors!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.
